heading: Computation of retired pay: law applicable
lead: A member of the armed forces retired under this chapter is entitled to retired pay computed under chapter 71 of this title.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 1275[No source].[No source]. The revised section is based on the various retirement provisions in this chapter and is inserted to make explicit the entitlement to retired pay upon retirement.
